title: serratula boetica subsp. legionensis
intro: Serratula boetica subsp. legionensis, commonly known as Legion's saw wort, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Iberian Peninsula, for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Serratula boetica subsp. legionensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities. However, the bioactive constituents of this plant are not extensively documented, and further research is necessary to fully understand its therapeutic potential.
